g.aria-label: Zybo top view locator, JE leftmost on lower edge

svg.text: JE is the leftmost lower-edge Pmod, next to the USB host corner.
02 / CONNECT JE TO THE DISTRIBUTION POINT
Four shared buses: +3V3, GND, I2S_SCK, I2S_WS.
Keep each MICx_SD on its own row. Leave JE8, JE9 and JE10 open.
Gray L/R straps connect to the same GND rail as the black leads.
R1: SD to GND, 100 kΩ • C1: VDD to GND, 100 nF at module
R2: SD to GND, 100 kΩ • C2: VDD to GND, 100 nF at module
R3: SD to GND, 100 kΩ • C3: VDD to GND, 100 nF at module
Matching rail or row tags are electrical junctions. Fit R and C unless equivalent parts are confirmed on the module.
